title: Mongolia: Ulaanbaatar to the Gobi
who: Classic route · overland in the Gobi by 4x4
vehicle: 4x4 with a driver or self-drive, 7–11 days
summary: South from the capital across the steppe into the Gobi: the eroded White Stupa cliffs, the ice-filled Yolyn Am gorge, the singing dunes of Khongoryn Els, the dinosaur cliffs of Bayanzag, then north to the old capital Karakorum. Tracks, not roads; nights in gers with herding families.
approximate: Main sights; the tracks are the drivers' choice, and the line is a guide only.

stops.name: Ulaanbaatar
stops.text: Stock up and download offline maps: little signal ahead.

stops.name: Tsagaan Suvarga
stops.text: Eroded white and pink cliffs, the "White Stupa".

stops.name: Yolyn Am
stops.text: A narrow gorge in the Gurvan Saikhan mountains where ice lasts into summer.

stops.name: Khongoryn Els
stops.text: Mongolia's largest dunes, about 100 km long and up to 300 m high; camel rides at sunset.

stops.name: Bayanzag
stops.text: The Flaming Cliffs, where the first dinosaur eggs were found.

stops.name: Karakorum
stops.text: Genghis Khan's capital and the Erdene Zuu monastery.
